p_prior_source: declared equal PS family mixture in prigm.toy_windows.make_toy_training, independent of alpha; finite training counts and historical execution not certified by this input
p_prior_role: family prior used in pooled mode; regime-known mode instead fixes the supplied p
information: observed alpha and endpoints; p marginalized
p_strata: held-out generating p is descriptive only in pooled mode
historical_law_note: frozen historical toy_eval used iid boundaries; current sample_boundaries uses stationary boundaries; caller must establish input lineage

entropy_definitions.path_entropy: H(S_1,...,S_12 | conditioning), with latent p marginalized

noisy_conditioning: context plus one fixed noisy input from the recorded target; low-noise concentration is legitimate posterior concentration, not mode collapse
context_conditioning: context only; each forward corruption starts from a fresh mixture-p then bridge draw; reference paths use an independent stream
score_note: Monte Carlo reference/self-scores are not an exact Bayes floor. Two-step endpoints are finite estimators without support projection.
